items.note: Partly fixed. The hint no longer gives away the b = a scenario: it now ends 'For a line with no new, ask where that reference came from.' It still opens by restating the model ('A variable declared in main goes in the frame, a field goes in the object its variable refers to, and an arrow ends at the object whose reference the variable was given'). That is teaching, not an added reasoning step (D5). The reconciler's suggested process step (note what each statement creates or changes, then ask whether the scenario names a variable or a field) was not adopted.

The program is now a <pre><code> block in the task, with '// Box 1' and '// Box 2' comments. At 570 px it fits without wrapping (scrollWidth 470 = clientWidth 470). Two short statements share a line in two places; this is readable.

Partly fixed. The teaching now includes 'after Box p = new Box(); p = null; no variable reaches that box, so it is eligible', a one-line example of the null case only. There is still no worked trace of what the task combines: a reassignment that moves a reference (a = c), and an alias (d = b) that keeps an object reachable after its original variable is set to null. The reconciler asked for a three- or four-line trace saying which box is reachable after each line.
Not changed. Every exercise still uses the toy `Box`; Activity 4 (grow/swap) was not reframed around a workplace object such as a Cart or Order, which the reconciler marked as fix now.
